pass: Priority 11 Autonomous Scale, Performance, Deployability & Mainframe Integration

findings.description: Scheduler lock deadlock during auto-registration from within enqueue_frame
findings.resolution: Upgraded FairStreamScheduler to use threading.RLock() enabling re-entrant acquisition.

findings.description: Database connection pool exhaustion when legacy repositories invoked get_connection() without closing
findings.resolution: Preserved direct psycopg connection creation for get_connection() while providing pooled connections via db_connection() and get_pooled_connection() with non-blocking ephemeral fallback.
